message: plan-build's PLAN/PROGRESS formats and the MCP's own writes (PROGRESS log headings, review-fix headings) put no blank line after headings, which markdownlint MD022 rejects; in a repo whose verify runs pre-commit with markdownlint, every task after the first task_done would fail. Had to plan a markdownlint exclusion for the pipeline artifacts as part of the first task.

planTaskFrom reads the first '**Depends on:**' anywhere in a task's text, so a task whose Design constraints mentioned that literal field name silently lost its real dependency (P1-10 parsed as depending on nothing). Caught only by re-parsing the plan with a script; the field should be matched only at the start of a line.

Round 1 implement finished "ready for review" and the reviewer ran, but CI on the draft PR was red: macOS failed on a GNU-only `sed -i` in a test fixture, and gitleaks flagged fake signing fixtures. Local verify cannot see either (Linux only, and the pre-commit gitleaks hook scans staged changes only). No stage checks PR CI status, so the human operator caught it.

The draft PR's CI was red (macOS-only sed -i in the test harness, and a gitleaks history scan of the PR's commits), but foundry_verify cannot see either, and the review-build skill has no step that reads `gh pr checks`. The operator had to relay the failures mid-review. A round-2+ review should check the PR's CI status itself.

foundry_mutate runs only verify commands, never the constraint scan, so a mutant that only a docs/foundry.json constraint catches (re-adding `sed -i` to test/harness.mjs, which no-gnu-sed-inplace's fixture names verbatim) reports "survived". The reviewer has to tell that apart from a real gap by hand.
